headline: Example Booking Software mentions on X spiked: 52 this week against an 8-week average of 20.5 (2.54 times), driven by the SMS reminder delays that started 2026-10-21. Competitor B spiked too, on X and Reddit, after a price change.
Share of voice across X, YouTube and Reddit rose to 30.1% from a 20.0% baseline, but it is not a win: 12 of the 17 reminder mentions read are negative, so the extra share is mostly complaints.
Net sentiment is -6 overall (n=49 mentions read) and -22 on X, with 25 mentions that need an answer, 6 of them unanswered on the brand's own pages.

unknowns_and_gaps: X posts: search_recent_posts reaches back 7 days from the moment of the call, so the posts read start at the run time on 2026-10-19 (the run was early on 2026-10-26). The week's X counts are complete because they came from get_post_counts_all.
TikTok: not covered. Its posts can't be searched through the connectors; paste them to include them.
Instagram posts by other accounts: not covered for the same reason; only comments on the brand's own posts are in.
Reddit: 1 brand thread had no date in Google's result. It is read for sentiment but left out of the counts.
Reddit engagement is unknown for threads found through Google results, so those rows count as 0 and rank last inside their group.
Competitor B on YouTube rose to 4 from an average of 1.88 (2.13 times) but stays under the floor of 5, so it is not a spike.

facts: SMS reminder texts were delayed on 21 and 22 October; they have been sending on time again since 22 October.
Support route for account and billing questions: a direct message to the brand with the account email.
Deposits are taken inside the booking flow, so clients pay when they book.
reply_facts_used.rule: Drafts state only these facts and what the post itself says. Anything else is left in [brackets] and listed under fill_before_posting.

replies_offered: Each draft in the top 10 of the answer queue shows its exact payload, marked not run. Nothing is posted until you confirm that reply.
